status: Guarded structural replacement and heading Enter verified in Rust; beta goal remains in progress
scope: Experimental operation and opt-in action only; no shipping browser or durable-format changes

contract.guards: Complete intersected source blocks including each kind, rank, text and typed formats
contract.replacement: Nonempty sequence of typed text-block fragments; source prefix attaches to first, suffix to last
contract.inverse: Locally derived and restores every original block kind independently
contract.publication: One atomic full-document validated result; no temporary split/delete state
contract.enter: Start/middle retain heading rank on both sides; at end right becomes paragraph; empty heading converts to paragraph without extra block
contract.selectedEnter: Retains start/end kinds spatially, except empty right suffix becomes paragraph; middle blocks removed
contract.history: One independent record; exact source selection, document and pending formats restored
contract.oldFormats: Operation V1–V4 still reject the new primitive; no new wire tag admitted
contract.remaining: Boundary/cross-block deletion action wiring, heading formatting, durable replay, browser integration, flat lists and desktop qualification

verification.clippy: Workspace all-target all-feature passed with warnings denied
developmentCorrections: Corrected compile-time API assumptions: immutable Children uses checked element access/iteration rather than slice indexing; codec encoding uses a bound codec instance.

Two focused runs each reported 58 passed and one fixture-construction failure (ParagraphSpanOverflow). The range contract rejects any u32::MAX end because publication needs an exclusive end. Final fixture separately asserts that constructor rejection and tests the maximum representable huge span (end u32::MAX - 1) against capture before allocation. Final seeded and core suites pass.
